title: Late-night library planning across quiet hours
notes: Quiet hours (STATE_MACHINE hard rule 3). The chat is first seen at Mon 20:30 (intro). The plan is started at Mon 22:33 with 'dinner tomorrow, wed or thu?', which gives options 1 Tue Oct 20 7pm, 2 Wed Oct 21 7pm, 3 Thu Oct 22 7pm and a deadline of Tue 13:00 (first option - 6h). Nudge A at 50% of the window is due at ~05:46 Tue, inside quiet hours, so it must move to 09:00 (or be merged/dropped under the noise budget); it must never go out at 05:46. Votes keep arriving until 23:52. Tariq's 'homi where are we at' at 23:05 is prompted, so Homi must answer it even in quiet hours. Vik, the only silent member, answers at 09:55, so the plan locks early on Wed (everyone answered) and the 13:00 deadline job is cancelled. 'tonight' in Vik's 09:55 message refers to Tue (the day it is sent). 'tomorrow' in Uma's 22:40 message also refers to Tue. Ren mixes a text vote with a 👎 tapback on option 1. Also covers 'no place needed', calendar, and a plan note. Food-word negative: 'the wifi is eating my soul'.
